abstract: Install and configure LibreChat, the self-hosted multi-user chat UI, against self-hosted LLM servers. Covers Docker Compose install and pinning, librechat.yaml custom endpoints for OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic Messages APIs (vLLM, llama.cpp, Ollama, LiteLLM, llama-swap), model-name mapping, key handling, tool calling, agents, reasoning replay, MCP servers, context and cost config, and troubleshooting, with templates and a read-only endpoint probe script.
